name: Service Capacity Safety
summary: Local integration policy for one pool and its sole guarded market.

protects.description: Avoid new capacity commitments under a stopped provider binding while preserving established escrow rights.

subjects: immutable provider of one capacity pool
resources: one pool on one chain with one guarded market
applicability.notes: Existing escrow cancellation, expiry, refunds, acceptance and rejection are outside the provider binding and follow the separate booking terms.

constraints.statement: Active bindings permit covered operations. Suspensions stop new commitments. Sets 4 or 5 allow already-admitted result submission only with no standing guardian stop and no uninterpreted response document; other failed checks close covered paths.

whoMayEnforce: fixed guardian named by the market requirement
authorityBasis: pool creation transaction and immutable provider/adapter records; buyer confirmation of immutable booking terms
Every ancestor must preserve the same provider, pool authority, fixed parameters and fixed guardian; no other account may hold its resume right.

channels.description: Every hold, confirmation, admission and result submission checks the fixed current binding. Confirmation checks again after the token transfer.
knownBypasses: Other pools and off-chain actions are outside this binding. Separate escrow recovery/settlement rights are explicitly outside its scope.

failureHandling.notes: No covered operation passes on an unknown or malformed registry response. Existing escrow rights remain enforceable independently. A nonzero responseRef on any suspended record closes delivery continuation until a supported response-document verifier exists. A standing guardian stop, or an unavailable stopOf query, closes continuation even when check reports Suspended first.

remedies.recovery: The named guardian may resume; the pool cannot replace its pinned binding.
serviceContinuity: Submit an already-admitted report under sets 4 or 5 only when the named guardian has no standing stop and all suspended records have zero responseRef.
remedies.compensation: Original immutable order refunds and settlement only; no new compensation right.

limitations: No proof of capacity outside this pool, actual computation, or report quality.
Refund and settlement rights have a separate pre-existing authority and are not frozen by this provider binding.
